description: 3-stage import validation bypass via ShouldBind content-type flexibility: (1) add POST /api/v1/accounts/import accepting JSON array of accounts with strict ShouldBindJSON and role validation (binding:"oneof=user viewer"), (2) add CSV import support with separate parser, (3) switch from ShouldBindJSON to ShouldBind for auto-detection. Result: form-encoded requests bypass the 'oneof' binding tag validator, allowing role=admin via Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
